title: Market
subtitle: Spotify France Top 200 shares by group, artist and genre — the morning capture, labels read from Spotify.

header.scope: Scope: Spotify France streams of the 200 tracks in the daily chart (kworb.net) — not the whole market. The group comes from the ℗ / © lines of each track's Spotify page: a label distributed under licence without saying so in its ℗ shows up as “Indie / other”.
